name: mail-certificate-renewed
description: A partner renewed its server certificate as announced and nothing changes for the user: worth knowing about a connection, nothing to do, so it is kept for the digest.

item.subject: Server certificate renewed as planned
item.text: Hello, as announced last month, we renewed the certificate of our order endpoint yesterday. The address and the issuing authority are unchanged, so nothing needs to change on your side. This message needs no reply. Thanks, Order Partner Operations
